# Union and intersection type oracle

`UnionIntersectionTypes.scala39-typed-tree.txt` records the Scala 3.9.0
typer output for simple unions and intersections, parser precedence and
parentheses, applied and qualified operands, a type alias, and a method
signature. The recorded tree keeps union and intersection nesting in the same
shape as the source grouping.

The fixture is pinned to Scala revision
`777528f19a58e794c9954a42f433373472ec57f8`.
